pages.text: Four records remain in the courtyard, gallery, laboratory, and core. Their writers remember a silent supply road, contradictory orders, two companions approaching a ring, and a guardian still awaiting XXX. Read them beside the places they describe; XXX’s fate remains uncertain.

Fallen banners mark the command hall. Follow the branching passages and stairs toward the laboratory, then look for the descent to the final watch. The survey needle gives a bearing, not a route through the walls. A mineralized miner in the courtyard holds a damaged core: break the remains and follow the $(l:world/mine_recovery)restoration path$().
